en: Surprise an opponent while you're knocked down by breaking their shins
A secret street fighting technique. Skillfully use a lit cigarette to create an opening.
Strike down your opponents with frightful speed.
Work with an ally to deliver a vicious blow.
After an ally smashes the back of your opponent's head into the ground with a powerbomb, cave in their face with a stomp.
Knee and headbutt a rising opponent to break his nose.
Ram a bike into your enemy putting all your weight behind it.
Glue two enemies together with superglue, then watch them struggle before viciously tearing them apart.
Launch a skyrocket at your enemy.
Unleash after Dragon Spirit to mow down surrounding enemies all at once.
Attack an enemy calling for backup, then smash his phone. No one's coming to save him now.
Build up power before delivering a savage kick. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Taunt enemies with the spirit of the white tiger to boost morale and increase your Heat Gauge.
Block enemy attacks with the spirit of the black tortoise to increase your Heat Gauge.
Earn more experience points when finishing off enemies with Heat Actions.
You will be less likely to recoil from enemy attacks while in Heat Mode.
The phoenix's spirit automatically fills up the Heat Gauge if your Health Gauge is flashing red.
Stay alive while in Heat Mode with the tireless strength of the azure dragon.
Guard against bladed weapons and bullets with your bare hands while in Heat Mode.
Recover health slightly using the Heat Gauge while in Heat Mode.
Heat Gauge rises slightly when landing an attack on an enemy even while Dragon Spirit is in effect.
Press the button at the right time to break your enemy's guard with the next attack of your combo.
A devastating strike executed after a Finishing Blow.
Leap in the air to deliver a powerful two-legged kick.
Swiftly regain your guard if it has been broken.
Allows you to the break an enemy's guard with certain attacks.
Knock enemies down by kicking the legs out from under them while rising to your feet.
Force a downed enemy onto his feet.
Regain your footing when you are about to get knocked down, then perform a counterattack.
Throw your enemy after unleashing a Finishing Blow.
Throw an enemy who has grabbed on to you.
Evade danger by performing Quickstep right after an attack. This will lower your Heat Gauge.
Boost your health's maximum value.
Escape enemy holds more easily.
Get back on your feet faster after getting knocked down.
Throw enemies you grab with greater ease.
Do more damage to surrounding enemies when hitting them with thrown enemies.
Pull off an impressive dodge by rolling after Quickstep.
Extend the time you are invulnerable during Quickstep.
Regain your footing to avoid getting knocked down.
Avoid recoiling from attacks during your combo by entering your next combo at the right time.
Deliver a vicious attack to a fallen enemy. Acquire new finishing moves the more you use it.
Boost the Heat Gauge's maximum value.
Show an enemy grabbing you that they should keep their hands to themselves by piledriving them.
Deal massive damage to an enemy by grating his face against the ground.
Deliver a vicious strike, then steal your enemy's weapon. Does not work against certain weapons.
Deliver a vicious attack by using an enemy's own large weapon against him.
Perform a powerful counter move against an enemy's attack. The move differs by direction.
Stop enemies with firearms from shooting, then deliver a vicious strike.
Deliver a powerful counterattack against an enemy's sword attack.
Boost the amount the Heat Gauge rises when attacking.
Unleash pent up rage to deliver powerful combos or throws for a short time.
Knock back your enemy while you are guarding creating a chance for a counterattack.
Evade enemy attacks with Quickstep while attacking at the same time.
Neutralize an enemy attack by parrying it, then knock your enemy out. Some enemies can't be knocked out.
Deliver a vicious counterattack while your enemy is attacking.
Improve the odds of Komaki Tiger Drop working by learning to better judge when enemies will attack.
Thrust your body into your enemy for major damage. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Perform the ultimate reversal move while at death's door. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
A brutal attack in which you slam your enemy's head in a car door with all your might.
Master the use of garbage cans to immobilize enemies by flipping them over their heads and into the trash.
Master the art of jamming lit stoves into enemy faces.
Master the use of pliers to tear the side of your enemy's face to shreds.
Unlock the second level of health and use food to boost different abilities.
Boost Strength, Focus, and Fighting Spirit to the second level to achieve greater bonuses.
Lower the rate at which the second level of health automatically declines.
Move the camera up, down, left, or right. Change the controls in Options from the Pause Menu.
This powerful finish after a Rush Combo sends your enemy flying.
A stronger Finishing Blow that is charged and unleashed after a Rush Combo.
Deliver a vicious brass knuckles attack that lifts your enemy into the air.
Trap your opponent and send them flying. Makes use of powerful centrifugal force.
Lift enemies up from between their legs and slam them onto the ground.
Pound the ground with built-up power to send enemies flying. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Raise the Heat Gauge by psyching yourself up.
Earn more experience points when finishing off enemies with charged attacks.
Dramatically raise your Heat Gauge by psyching yourself up to the extreme.
Run to build up speed, then deliver a powerful ramming attack.
Swing an enemy around like a weapon, then hurl him at surrounding enemies.
Build up power, then deliver a violent knee strike to the enemy you grabbed.
Deliver a violent Finishing Blow after a Super Double Combo.
Deliver a powerful uppercut after building up power.
Unleash a violent throw that starts with Tiger Charge. <Color:255,255,150,255>Lowers the Heat Gauge when activated.<Color:Default>
Build up enormous power, then whirl while crashing into your enemy.
Swing an enemy around, then bash him into the ground, striking other enemies.
Throw enemies you grab with even greater ease.
Further boost damage to surrounding enemies when hitting them with thrown enemies.
Boost the damage of the next attack of a combo by pressing the button at just the right time.

Grab the legs of an enemy to give him a brutal
clothesline and a nice view of the sky.
Slam a gigantic weapon into your enemy then strike him again as only the powerfully built Saejima could.
Carry your enemy over to a wall, then perform a heroic throw.
Grab an enemy's head and swing him around like a weapon, bludgeoning other enemies all around.
Deliver a devastating blow with a giant piece of equipment ripped out of the ground.
Lift up an enemy who bounced back from a wall, then ram him into it again full force.
Catch your opponents on guard! Sweep out the feet of guarding enemies to watch them crumble.
Grab a fallen enemy and swing him around like a weapon, striking other enemies all around.
Rip equipment or a road sign out of the ground, then use it as a devastating weapon.
Lift up an enemy you have grabbed, then slam him down. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Never flinch from enemy attacks as long as you are in Heat Mode.
Charge forward and send your enemy flying. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Violently roll your enemy in the snow, turning him into a human snowman.
Smash a potted plant over an enemy's head. An eco-friendly takedown.
Disable an enemy with your mastery of the bicycle tire.

Perform a combo that can lead to a variety of other attacks. Transition to a Slash Kick by pressing <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat> three times and then mashing <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat>.
Violently slam your enemy against a guard rail, then finish him off with a kick.
Race up a pole and use the height advantage to deliver a vicious kick.
Deliver a series of vicious kicks to an enemy you have slammed against a wall.
Send enemies out of the park with a powerful swing.
Use a long pole to launch your body high in the air and deliver a vicious attack.
A secret technique where you jump and knee the face of an enemy that was picked up and thrown.
Deliver a combo of assorted kicks. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Squat down and taunt a downed enemy.
Taunt an enemy you grabbed by glaring at him.
Taunt your enemy as you get up from the ground.
Earn more experience points when you finish off an enemy with Launch Strike.
Your attacks grow more powerful while you are drunk.
Your Heat Gauge will rise higher when using any kind of taunt.
Raise your Heat Gauge gain on your next attack by pressing the button at the right time.
Deliver a vicious Finishing Blow after a Double Finishing Kick
Boost the attack speed of the Rush Combo.
Take major evasive actions by performing Quickstep twice in a row.
The Heat Gauge will not go down when you use Evasive Quickstep.
Enemies will be unable to guard against Launch Strike.
Perform an extremely evasive Quickstep that your enemy cannot score a hit on.
A vicious drop to the face of a fallen enemy.
Mow down your enemies with a trinity of strikes.
When you are in danger after your guard is broken, turn the tables with a backspin kick.
Deliver a powerful strike to an airborne enemy, then slam him to the ground.
Turn your back on your enemy, then deliver a debilitating kick when he least expects it.
Launch your enemy back into the air after slamming him down with Alpha Drive.
After Beta Drive, violently kick your enemy away while he is still in the air.

Launch your enemy into the air, then deliver a violent combo attack. Unleash with <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat><Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat><Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> or <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> while running.
Increase the number of times Slash Kick can be performed.
Deliver a devastating attack as you come hurtling down. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Increase the number of times Launch Strike can be performed.
Violently slam an airborne enemy down to the ground. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Send one enemy into the air, and while he is helpless, slam another nearby enemy into him.
After mastering the use of bikes as a weapon, you can now send them rolling into enemies.
After mastering the use of beer crates, you can slam them over an enemy's head to blind them.
After mastering the use of the bowling ball as a weapon, you can now strike enemies with your superb bowling form.
Slightly recover your health through proper breathing and concentration during a dance battle.
Wake the Fighting Spirit that sleeps within you to raise your Spirits one level during a dance battle.
Recover your health through even better breathing and concentration during a dance battle.
Lower your opponent's Spirits one level by showing off your hunger for victory during a dance battle.
Recover even more of your health through intense breathing control and concentration during a dance battle.
Wake even greater Fighting Spirit within you to raise your Spirits two levels during a dance battle.
Lower your opponent's Spirits two levels by showing off an even greater hunger for victory during a dance battle.
Win the hearts of the crowd with a sweet performance during a dance battle, causing your opponent's Heat to fall a bit.
Learn the ropes so that you can slightly decrease the health you lose due to the fatigue that results if you fail at a job.
Win the hearts of the crowd with a seriously sweet performance during a dance battle, causing your opponent's Heat to fall.
